newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.929 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.929 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.929 percent, up from the previous issue's 1.748 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on December 27, raised 955.25 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.520 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on December 19, raised 1,200.20 million and was priced at 99.560 percent.
